findings.route: Keep as disclosed history; do not cite 2236 as an independent critique or Review.

findings.title: #96 UI Review follow-up: a saved file with a byte-order mark is not posted literally
findings.evidence: role-screens.js:1403 decodes with TextDecoder('utf-8', {fatal:true}) and no ignoreBOM, which strips a leading BOM; the UI review and the pack/README wording say the file text is posted unchanged. No ignoreBOM option exists at the frozen head.
findings.impact: README sentence 'posts the original file text unchanged' is true only for files without a BOM. A BOM file would be answered by the server from altered text. The review recorded this as a Low follow-up, and it remains open (source is frozen and not corrected here).
findings.route: Later owner-admitted fix or a wording qualification; consumes the remaining #96 allowance only if the owner chooses a source change (two remain).
